parent_objective: audit no-rollout protocol preflight before measured execution design
blocked_by: M1683 protocol must be audited before any measured rollout design or execution

public_gates: M1684 must audit M1683 summary protocol and workload_matrix artifacts
M1684 must verify workload cell count strata and zero rollout count
M1684 must verify hidden/action target leakage remains zero
M1684 must choose measured-execution design, protocol repair, or branch synthesis route
M1684 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-rollout protocol before measured execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1683 artifacts are missing
stop if workload or strata coverage is incomplete
stop if hidden/action target leakage is nonzero
stop if audit routes directly to private holdout or paper evidence
fallback_plan: route to measured-execution design if audit passes
route to protocol repair if workload or strata fail
route to branch synthesis if execution design would exceed cadence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1683 materializes no-rollout protocol and requires audit before measured execution design

admission_evidence: M1683 reports 72 specs, 12 profiles, 864 workload cells, required strata present, zero leakage and zero rollout
allowed_updates: M1684 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for measured-execution design, protocol repair, or branch synthesis

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; audit must preserve future L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls.
history_necessity_tests: audit must not claim history necessity from protocol artifacts
audit must require any measured execution design to compare current-substitution controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If protocol is incomplete, repair before execution rather than weakening evidence standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1683's no-rollout protocol is complete enough to admit measured-execution design while preserving strata and controller controls.
success_criteria: M1683 summary protocol and workload_matrix are audited
workload cell count strata leakage and rollout-count status are explicit
next measured-execution design repair or synthesis route is explicit
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: M1683 workload strata or leakage status is not checked
audit routes directly to rollout execution private holdout promotion or paper evidence
audit claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
decision_rule: M1684 passes if it audits M1683 and admits only measured-execution design, repair, or synthesis.
